description: Append fresh correction and replacement tasks, close the workspace dependency lock, and retarget undispatched alpha integration.

append_waves.description: Correct the accepted care contract and replace rejected conversation and responsibility attempts.

tasks.title: Correct authoritative care timing and persisted resolution contracts
tasks.spec: Apply a forward-only public-contract correction. Remove caller-supplied acknowledgedAt and handledAt from AcknowledgeCareEvent and HandleCareEvent requests. Define Clock.now as the sole authoritative transition, deadline, persistence, idempotency, and audit time for those commands. Add a bounded CareResolution to handled events, preserve it when a handled event closes, and add resolution to the content-free audit change-field contract. Update examples and technical documentation without changing unrelated APIs, error codes, or product semantics.
acceptance: Strict request schemas reject acknowledgedAt and handledAt supplied by callers
Handled events require one bounded resolution and closed events preserve any prior handling resolution
Audit changes can record only the bounded resolution enum and never free-form care content
Examples cover valid acknowledgement, handling, closure, invalid timestamps, missing resolution, and invalid resolution
The operation registry and every public schema example validate
No unrelated command, query, privacy, handover, or UI contract changes

tasks.title: Replace private conversation and consented signal safety boundaries
tasks.spec: Implement a fresh conversation capability from the accepted DATA-001 baseline without merging the rejected attempt. Authorize the active actor, space, private message, evidence ownership, evidence state, and analysis consent before any provider invocation. Detect every frozen high-risk category deterministically before provider invocation. Do not allow provider free text to flow directly into a shared conclusion; prefer bounded provider fields plus human-authored application templates. Apply the same disclosure guard to every provider-derived field that can reach a draft or shared signal. Normalize Unicode, case, whitespace, and punctuation when rejecting exact and near-verbatim private-input variants. Revalidate consent, evidence, visibility, and versions transactionally before ConfirmSignal persists a shared record.
acceptance: Unauthorized, inactive, cross-space, missing, or mismatched source input fails before provider invocation and provider call count remains zero
Self-harm, domestic-violence, and acute-medical fixtures bypass the provider and cannot create an ordinary task or automatic shared signal
Provider-derived conclusions cannot publish private raw content
Exact copies and near-verbatim variants with case, whitespace, punctuation, Unicode, or one-character changes fail closed
Invalid output, timeout, provider failure, and second invalid output produce needs_human_review without consequential mutation
Logs and errors contain only identifiers and bounded outcome metadata

tasks.title: Replace responsibility attribution and neutral deterministic reporting
tasks.spec: Implement a fresh responsibility capability from DATA-001 without merging the rejected attempt. Validate active membership, space ownership, authorized task IDs, authorized signal IDs, evidence state, review state, versions, and bounded input before constructing or sending any provider request. Provider input may contain only authorized redacted shared facts. Revalidate before consequential persistence. Keep attribution corrections and reports deterministic over the five persisted responsibility stages. Generate user-facing report narratives from human-authored Chinese templates; AI may only draft a bounded domain suggestion requiring human confirmation.
acceptance: Unauthorized task, signal, evidence, actor, or space input fails before provider invocation and provider call count remains zero
No raw evidence or unauthorized structured identifier crosses the provider boundary
Every report value traces to persisted responsibility fields and authorized current signals
Discussion-only, evidence_missing, and needs_review facts are excluded deterministically
Corrections require an authorized actor, expected version, and content-free audit metadata
Representative uneven workloads use neutral Chinese copy without score, rank, blame, or diagnosis

append_waves.description: Persist the corrected contracts and replace the rejected web runtime attempt.

tasks.title: Apply forward database corrections for signal evidence and care resolution
tasks.spec: Apply forward-only PostgreSQL and Drizzle corrections without rewriting the accepted initial migration or its snapshot. Add a signal-specific evidence-state enum with available and evidence_missing. Add bounded care-resolution storage, handled/closed consistency constraints, resolution audit-field support, repository mappings, a new migration, a new Drizzle snapshot, and journal updates. Verify both upgrade-from-0000 and fresh-all-migrations paths in a disposable PostgreSQL instance.
acceptance: The accepted 0000 migration and 0000 snapshot remain byte-identical
A new forward migration converts signals to a signal-specific available or evidence_missing enum
Care handling persists one bounded resolution and closure preserves it
Database constraints reject handled events without resolution and reject resolution without a corresponding handled timestamp
System-catalog evidence proves enum values, columns, constraints, indexes, and audit-field support
Upgrade and fresh-install disposable PostgreSQL tests pass without committed or printed credentials

tasks.title: Replace the fixture experience with a real Next.js runtime proof
tasks.spec: Implement a fresh fixed-data Chinese Next.js experience without merging the rejected attempt. Cover primary carer, partner, and older subject flows and every frozen UI state. Commit next-env.d.ts and an experience-local Playwright configuration under apps/web/tests that starts the real Next.js server. Browser assertions and screenshots must navigate the rendered application; a test-only renderer is not acceptable. Preserve the typed fixture client seam and do not connect database or module handlers.
acceptance: A production Next.js build succeeds from committed runtime files
Playwright starts the real Next.js application and navigates the rendered route
390x844 and 1440x900 checks cover all three roles without clipping, overlap, or obscured primary actions
Loading, empty, blocked, denied, error, retry, and success states are visible
Keyboard focus, target size, contrast, and reduced-motion behavior meet the frozen contract
Fixture and non-production identity labels remain visible and no blame, score, diagnosis, or silent-success copy appears

append_waves.description: Replace care, privacy, and golden-fixture attempts from the corrected database baseline.

tasks.title: Replace deterministic care scheduling, acknowledgement, and handling
tasks.spec: Implement a fresh care capability against CONTRACT-CORR-001 and DATA-CORR-001 without merging the rejected attempt. Read Clock.now once per command and use that reading for all deadline decisions, transition timestamps, idempotency persistence, and audits. Acknowledgement is timely only when server now is strictly before the acknowledgement deadline; equality or lateness cannot suppress escalation. Persist and audit the bounded handling resolution and retain it through closure. Enforce one PostgreSQL lock order: care events in deterministic ID order before care rules in deterministic ID order. Add a credential-free disposable PostgreSQL race test using existing locked dependencies and a care-local harness.
acceptance: Caller-controlled timestamps cannot backdate acknowledgement or handling
Acknowledgement succeeds only when Clock.now is strictly before the deadline
At the exact deadline or later, acknowledgement cannot suppress the due timeout or escalation
Handling requires the current escalation recipient and persists and audits the bounded resolution
Closure preserves the handling resolution
Concurrent scheduler and acknowledgement transactions complete without deadlock, duplicate event, or contradictory terminal result
Repeated ticks, acknowledgements, and handling requests are idempotent
No path uses an LLM, wall-clock sleep, Date.now, or free-form care resolution

tasks.title: Replace privacy export and deterministic deletion policies
tasks.spec: Implement a fresh privacy capability from DATA-CORR-001 without merging the rejected attempt. Map inactive, missing, or otherwise unauthorized export actors to the dedicated export_not_authorized contract error without returning partial content or revealing record existence. Preserve explicit actor authorization for raw evidence, consent revocation, personal export, evidence deletion, and full space deletion. Use the corrected signal evidence-state mapping and keep accepted handover ownership intact during evidence deletion.
acceptance: Inactive, missing, wrong-space, and unauthorized export actors receive export_not_authorized
Every ExportMyData result or error parses through the frozen public contract
Denied export returns no partial bundle and creates no content-bearing log
Authorized export contains only the actor-authorized minimum
Evidence deletion sets dependent signals to evidence_missing, marks affected tasks and domains needs_review, and re-excludes reports
Evidence deletion preserves accepted handover history and current ownership
Space deletion removes in-space product and audit content and returns only an ephemeral non-content receipt

tasks.title: Replace golden fixtures with one coherent public-contract graph
tasks.spec: Build one canonical fictional household graph and derive every fixture, scenario, expected report, deletion receipt, handover receipt, reminder set, and evidence label from that graph. Import contracts only through @we-remember/contracts and declare the workspace dependency in packages/testkit/package.json. Do not deep-import packages/contracts/src. Evidence deletion must preserve accepted ownership, invalidate only dependent projections, and recompute reports. Handover may migrate only active future reminders belonging to the transferred domain. Add identity and ownership invariant tests that fail on cross-graph IDs or stale derived facts. Add root Playwright discovery and webServer configuration for later integration; browser execution remains owned by INT-001.
acceptance: All scenarios use IDs from one canonical fixture graph
Reports and receipts are derived from current tasks, signals, domains, handovers, and deletion state rather than duplicated constants
Evidence deletion preserves the accepted owner and recomputes report counts after invalidation
Handover changes only the transferred domain and its active future reminders
The testkit declares @we-remember/contracts as a workspace dependency and imports only its public package export
Cross-entity tests fail for unknown IDs, wrong-space IDs, ownership drift, stale report rows, and unrelated reminder migration
Fixtures contain only fictional data and preserve explicit Fixture and evidence-level labels

append_waves.description: Synchronize the accepted QA workspace dependency into the foundation-owned lockfile.

acceptance: The only changed path relative to QA-REPAIR-001 is pnpm-lock.yaml
The lockfile records packages/testkit and its workspace dependency on @we-remember/contracts
No external dependency version, integrity, override, or package manifest changes
A clean frozen install succeeds
The public-package QA checks pass after the frozen install

update_tasks.title: Assemble the corrected alpha and connect real module adapters
update_tasks.spec: Start from the exact accepted FOUND-LOCK-001 SHA, which must contain accepted QA-REPAIR-001, DATA-CORR-001, and CONTRACT-CORR-001 ancestry. Merge the exact accepted remote SHAs for EXPR-REPAIR-001, CONV-REPAIR-001, RESP-REPAIR-001, HAND-001, CARE-REPAIR-001, and PRIV-REPAIR-001 with clean --no-ff merges. Never merge or cherry-pick rejected EXPR-001, CONV-001, RESP-001, CARE-001, PRIV-001, or QA-001 commit objects. Add only integration-owned actor boundaries, command/query composition, routes, database wiring, and demo documentation. Preserve Fixture and non-production truth labels.
acceptance: FOUND-LOCK-001 is the exact integration base and QA-REPAIR-001, DATA-CORR-001, and CONTRACT-CORR-001 are verified ancestors
Every non-ancestor dependency SHA is an exact second parent of a clean no-ff merge
HAND-001 remains the accepted handover implementation and is not repeated or replaced
No rejected Attempt SHA is an ancestor of the integrated alpha
The seven-step Fixture flow runs through real command/query handlers and disposable PostgreSQL
Server-side authorization and pre-provider authorization remain effective
Blocked, denied, provider-failed, database-failed, care-boundary, deletion, and export paths remain explicit
Both browser viewports render the real Next.js application without regression
README and demo documentation distinguish Fixture, local runtime, public deployment, and official acceptance
